key_insight: Feature-fused 3-D active vision automatically extracts planar V-groove welding trajectories on reflective materials while suppressing reflection interference.
engineering_relevance: The approach supports automated weld-path generation where reflective surfaces complicate optical seam detection.
method: Segment laser stripes using a saliency feature fusion model (SFF_LSM).
Extract stripe centers using a gray-gravity algorithm with secondary smoothing.
Filter seam point clouds and fit the welding trajectory using least squares.
evidence_signal: Experiments reported maximum trajectory-fitting errors of 0.51 mm in X, 0.40 mm in Y, and 0.29 mm in Z.
watch_item: The abstract does not establish robustness across different materials, groove geometries, or production lighting conditions.
paper_title: Automatic extraction of welding trajectories for V-groove welds based on 3-D active vision imaging
